test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence:

She said, "Don't you understand the seriousness of the matter?"

options.text: She asked why I didn't understand the serious matter.
She asked whether I didn't understand the seriousness of the matter.
She asked if I understood the seriousness of the matter.
She asked do I understand how serious it is.

solution:
The correct answer is '**She asked whether I didn't understand the seriousness of the matter.**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **direct speech** and is an **interrogative sentence**.
 
• While converting an interrogative sentence into indirect speech: 
 
 
• The reporting verb "**said**" changes to "**asked**".
 
• The conjunction "**whether**" or "**if**" is used for a yes/no question.
 
• The sentence changes from interrogative to assertive form.
 
 
 
• Since the original question is negative ("**Don't you understand...?**"), the negative sense is retained in the reported speech.
 
• Therefore, **Option 2** is the most appropriate answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Indirect Speech:** *"She asked **whether I didn't understand the seriousness of the matter.**__"*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** incorrectly changes the meaning by using "**why**" instead of "**whether/if**".
 
• **Option 3** omits the negative sense present in the original question.
 
• **Option 4** is grammatically incorrect because it retains the interrogative word order in indirect speech.
